internal_error_resource_probe.description: 1000 retained internal RangeErrors, checked for kind and nonempty message. Accounted engine resources, not process RSS or linear-memory high-water.
internal_error_resource_probe.source: let errors=[];for(let i=0;i<1000;i++){try{new Array(-1)}catch(e){errors.push(e)}}function probe(){let ok=0;for(const e of errors)if(e instanceof RangeError&&typeof e.message==='string'&&e.message.length>0)ok++;return ok}

async_resource_probe.description: 1000 async activations suspended on one shared Promise, then resumed and checked. Accounted engine resources, not process RSS or linear-memory high-water.
async_resource_probe.source: let release;const blocker=new Promise(r=>{release=r});let count=0;async function hold(){await blocker;count++}let pending=[];for(let i=0;i<1000;i++)pending.push(hold());function finish(){release(0)}function probe(){return count}
